ASTRA

Eaglercraft with capes, a mod menu and a cleaner title screen. Runs in your browser, nothing to install.

See versions

Versions

Every version keeps its own worlds and settings. If you're not sure, pick 1.8.8.

Capes

Pick one in the launcher and it's on your player when the game starts. It goes through Eaglercraft's own cape system, so other players on the server see it too. 1.8.8 and 1.12.2 only.

What's in it

Press RSHIFT in game to open the mod menu.

HUD mods

FPS, CPS, keystrokes, clock, session timer, memory and battery. Drag any of them wherever you want on screen.

Zoom and visuals

Hold C to zoom, add a custom crosshair, or brighten the game with a color filter.

Title screen

Astra logo, dark buttons and a new background on the main menu (1.8.8 and 1.12.2).

Capes

Eight capes to pick from, plus a username you set once and keep.

Accounts

Make an Astra account and your cape, mods and HUD layout follow you to any computer.

Multiplayer

Join Eaglercraft servers, or open your singleplayer world to friends through relays.

FAQ

Which version should I pick?

1.8.8 is the most stable and what most servers run. 1.8.8 WASM is the same game but faster on recent Chrome and Edge. 1.12.2 has newer blocks and mobs but is still early and buggy. 1.5.2 is the original classic.

Do I need an account?

No. Everything works without one and saves in your browser. An account just keeps your cape, mods and HUD layout when you switch devices.

Why no capes on 1.5.2?

1.5.2 uses an older profile format without custom capes, so it only gets the mod menu.

Is there 1.21?

Not yet. The community 1.21 ports we tried freeze before the main menu. It'll be added once one actually works.

Where are my worlds saved?

In your browser's storage for this site. Clearing site data deletes them, so back up worlds you care about from inside the game.
